note: 0.3.1 PK rules for PK zones (data/pk_zones.json, 'the Scorch'). Anyone may attack anyone there (player <-> AI, AI <-> AI); every PK zone is multi-combat. The first actor to strike another (not retaliating within skull_minutes) is SKULLED for skull_minutes (1 min = 100 ticks) and keeps nothing on death. Dying in a PK zone: keep the keep_items most valuable item units (worn + pack; coins are never kept), everything else drops in a pile that is private to the killer for killer_private_ticks then public. If a creature killed you, the pile is yours for npc_kill_private_ticks then public. The town healer still takes the normal coin fee (10%) from carried coin. pvp: accuracy = base + (Attack + gear atk) x atk_per - (Defence x def_level_per + gear def x def_gear_per) x (1 - armour_break), clamped; max hit = the normal formula. AI: carry_coins = coins an adventurer-class AI has on it in the zone (+ carry_coin_share of its purse); carry_food = food units it brings.
warning_text:
You are entering the Scorch, a lawless burnt land in the north.

- Anyone can attack you here, players and AI alike, and many may attack you at once (multi-combat).
- If you die here you keep only your 3 most valuable items. Everything else drops for your killer.
- Attack someone first and you are skulled for 10 minutes: while skulled you keep nothing.

Tap an AI player here to attack them.

ai.new_players_note: AI killed inside a PK zone quits; a new level-1 player takes the slot (AdvBrain.reincarnate): starter_kit tools, starter_coins marks; its bank + kept items go to an estate sale on the Exchange (price = estate_price x reference, proceeds are a sink, unsold after estate_ticks are lost).
